set.body: Studio amendment C3 to CR6. The Phrase/MethodsText model gets typed fact slots (e.g. EligibleQueries, RecordsOutsideWindow, GroupSizeRange, DatasetRevision, a confound sentence), filled from the UI-C Report and from run and inspection values, so one token model renders the whole S9.4 methods paragraph. The slot types live in plan; the renderer that fills them lives in eyes4s-results. After CR6b.
